_doc: Thresholds of tools/gates/ready.py. Why each one is enough: docs/READINESS.md. Change a threshold only with a journal entry.

equiv_by_design._doc: S11 rules whose differences docs/EQUIVALENCE.md records as by design; S1b sites come from docs/PATCHES.md 'By-design MSVC differences'

_abi_verdicts_doc: S1b's tests/s1b/pop/abiclass.py verdicts that explain an x86-inconsistent pair (J-0141): patched (the caller is an S1b site at the head that the link did not have yet: the next link drops the row) and benign-* (no native effect: extra words ignored, words never read, no call, only who pops differs). Tables: the gates job's --abiclass dir, else link/<c12>/out/abiclass.tsv

static_closed._doc: a non-benign S12 class counts as closed only while its fix is present in this checkout (file + regex)

_player_exe_doc: the sha256 the gamedata/exe checksum line for FalloutNV.exe must give (fixture: made up)

perf._doc: frame-rate levels (owner decision J-0150, replacing J-0132): the target is 60 fps, a 16.7 ms whole frame, at the 1.02 GHz retail clock and 720p handheld, judged on the worst frame; below 30 fps is a fail; 45 fps is kept as an informational level only. Each frame gate is evaluated at every clock; only clocks with required=true count for the verdict (stock), the boost clock is informative

budget._doc: S15 whole-frame budget (fnvnx-frame-budget/1, tools/perf/frame_budget.py, docs/PERF.md 11): reports/<farm>/<c12>-frame-budget.json, else the checkout's model file; the scenario as the build is placed today, its verdict for the target per clock (target_60: the mid worst frame <= 16.7 ms, J-0150)

render_perf._doc: render machine report (docs/RENDER_PERF.md section 5). perf.render.<clock>: summary.targets_budget_fraction (the renderer's worst thread / the target's frame, hi bound = IPC 0.6, mix_hi; not summary.targets, which compares the renderer alone with the whole frame) against max_budget_fraction, the renderer's share of the frame (RENDER_NATIVE.md 9.4: render thread 4.5 of 22.2 ms, 3.5 of 16.7 ms); without the fractions, from frame_ms gate values scaled from assumptions.clock_ghz. perf.gpu.<config>: gpu.summary_ms.<gpu_mix>.<config>, efficiency 1.0 (lo) - 0.6 (hi, judged), a model with no measured anchor, so informative until required is set

scorecard._doc: the honest scorecard's frame rows (ready.py scorecard()): 60 fps at 720p handheld at the 1.02 GHz retail clock (J-0150), the same target as the frame gates (perf.fps)

_report_due_s_doc: a pass whose source is behind the head and older than this (s, against the newest publish time) is overdue: stale, not a pass

trend._doc: fnvnx-trend/1: the gates job keeps the per-head scorecard history in its JSON sidecar (reports/<farm>/<c12>-gates.json, private repo); ready.py reads the newest one and appends
